body.p: (...). (...). Now I will of the old, old people.[ShA:] The researcher asks in Russian the speaker to start.[ShA:] The researcher and the speaker discuss in Russian if everything is ready for the recording. This would be life story or anything, let me tell the tale. Long ago, well. There lived one-legged people, near the freak cape. If one finds them somewhere. ... well, two living men saw them, after all. They had no wives, they had only reindeer. They had only reindeer. Their reindeer walked around there themselves. Along the freak cape. Once their reindeer, say, come with broken antlers. My god! Why then reindeer's antlers break? It seems, there are no people here. Why then reindeer's antlers break? One person lacked intelligence a bit. And the other one, what, was a clever person, a clever one. He went carefully in the evening along this cape. Once he saw people. People appeared from under the ground. He lied down quietly. He thought. Oh, my eyes, probably, look wrong. What would be this person, is she goes out from under the ground? Then, the next time. Carefully in the evening. The reindeer again came frightened. Their antlers, all their antlers became broken. Then he looks, looks, looks carefully. He says, he says in his mind, say. Let me go! Why our reindeer got frightened? So he went carefully. Again people exit from there. From under the ground. My god, what people ..., he said. Here during our life we always lived here. There were no people here. Well, let it be so. He didn't say anything to his mate. This mate, well. A bit he had not enough intelligence. He was a foolish person. Then he said. Another time. Now, then. Now, he said, let me not release you. ... I will look at you. What kind of people you are. So, well, the next day. His reindeer again came with broken antlers. And they are frightened themselves. My god! So went this man carefully the cape. He went down along the cape. One of them wearing a very red, red outerwear. A girl appeared. All her head is decored with iron. Oh, he did not know women, after all, his heart started moving a very lot. He said. Oh, if I caught this one somehow. Women, he did not know women, after all. Oh, this is a woman, after all, if I caught her somehow. She has two legs, she is a true human, a human. She has two legs, two arms. Well, he so carefully approached, approached to her. Oh, she put a huge pail onto the ground. Carefully, say, he said. Come here more close, are you a human or someone else. She goes carefully to this man, say. He caught her carefully. They spoke, spoke carefully. She is a true human, absolutely a human. So she wears a red outerwear. She is all wearing iron, her head is in iron. ... he spoke. Well, so they spoke some time somehow, probably. Then, well. At some time this one said. That man said. Won't you come tomorrow again at this time? Well, this. However, she spoke. It seems, she said: I will come! After this person saw this person, well, this woman. He started always going there in the evening. He always leaves at that time. At the sunset. When the sun goes down. This man leaves at this time. This woman says: Let you come at this time! At this time he left again. This woman again appeared. She carries a huge copper pail. She went down for water. He caught here again carefully. Well, let it be so. This. Then he went home. His mate said: You are there for a long time? Where are you so long? I cannot wait for you. What do you do there? Alone in the forest. Oh, he did not tell it. He does not tell it. ..., he would think. You will see myself. As for him, he probably thought: I would take her as a wife. So, well, he went to the woman. Having come to the woman, he caught her strongly. This woman. So, as she wears a good outerwear, she is a true human. She is all in iron, her head is in iron. He caught her very strongly. This fool. He was following his mate, after all. He keeps watch on his mate. What's there, what my mate goes for? So he called his mate from the back. He is holding strongly that woman. When he saw her, his heart also flinched, of course. His heart of course, started working. Hold her strongly! Hold her strongly! I have come now! Let's catch her together! So this woman. She shook strongly one hand. She became single-eyed, she became single-legged. She is hidden under the ground, only her cry left. And this man, well, after all. Oh you! What dogs did you look for? I would find now a wife for me, after all. She would sew for us. He, when they came home. They quarelled because of this.[ShA:] The syntax is not completely clear.What dogs did you look for? I would find now a person for myself. Something would be sewed for me.[ShA:] The syntax is not completely clear. What for did you run behind me? What for did you cry? So.He strongly criticized his mate at home. They quarelled. Of course, he abuses. He frightened, after all, his mate, the person he wanted to take. Then. She did not appear for three days. That, the lower part, from under the ground. She did not appear for three days. At some time the third day. This man carefully. Looked at them, say. Their huge copper boat. In the direction of the sunset. Well, it is turned towards the cape of the freaks. All of them sat down into a huge copper boat. There were a lot of people under the ground. That woman appeared the last, say. She is carrying a child in one hand. So, she already got a baby from this man. She took the child. She is carrying a child on an elbow of her hand. They sat down into their copper boat. So, they swam towards the sunset. So, having come home he said to his mate. Now at least you find a wife for yourself! I said, after all, why do you pursue me? So, you have frightened my people now. So, they quarelled with his mate. So to say, they remained living only two of them. So.
